This week @USDA proposed common-sense changes to more than double the healthy eating opportunities for our most vulnerable populations by strengthening the stocking requirements for retailers participating in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). 

We're seeking to raise the bar for stocking by: 
 
▪️Increasing variety requirements to seven per staple food category, more than DOUBLING the food choices required
▪️Closing loopholes that allow certain snack foods to count as staple foods
▪️Simplifying food classification, making standards easier for retailers to understand and @USDA_FNS to enforce
 
These changes will reorient SNAP towards better nutrition and emphasizing whole, healthy food for program participants. 

With the help of Dr. @RealBenCarson, who was officially sworn in this week as the USDA National Nutrition Advisor, we are delivering on @POTUS’s promise to turn the tide on chronic disease and MAKE AMERICA HEALTHY AGAIN! 🥗

👏 Thank you, @DrMakaryFDA. Big step forward!
